domain: AMENDMENT-CADENCE-LATENCY (axis 2: amendment-process structure; conditioning on the PROCESS - cadence, chain shape, depth - never on corrected values)
title: Restatement-process latency: long punctual-process filers, short vintage-patch-latent filers, per-sector net-zero on the death-inclusive cohort, conditioned on last_avail amendment stamps

mechanism.who_is_forced_to_trade_or_slow_to_react: The constrained actor is the issuer's financial-reporting and audit apparatus (management, controllers, external auditor). Once an already-submitted, certified vintage of a field-period exists, every later re-addressal of that same certified period is a compelled act of that apparatus: it cannot be scheduled for convenience, it is dragged out by internal friction (re-audit scope, committee review, restatement workflow). The slow-to-react actor is the marginal holder, who attends to earnings headlines and treats vintage-stamp events as noise (limited attention), so the latency of the patch process is not repriced when it accrues.
mechanism.why_the_process_shape_reveals_state: The SHAPE of the amendment process - how long the machinery takes between successive vintages of the same certified field-period - is itself evidence about the state of that machinery. An inter-arrival far above the annual reporting rhythm (> 460 days, the funded pooled p90 of the V11-E3-AMEND-CADENCE clock) means a certified period was re-addressed long after the fact: restatement-process latency. The reporting-timeliness and internal-control literature ties delayed reporting to disclosure friction, material internal-control weakness and elevated information risk; a latency-heavy chain pattern is therefore a persistent disclosure-quality state, not a one-off. Because the market underreacts to low-salience vintage events, that state persists into subsequent relative underperformance and an elevated death hazard - both measurable only on the death-inclusive cohort (latency-heavy filers are disproportionately eventual dead names: 1,023,812 of the 1,667,422 chain groups belong to DEAD_EVIDENCED entities per the P0 census; a survivor-only panel would censor exactly that mass out of the short leg). Critically, the signal uses ONLY the spacing of evidenced stamps: which values were corrected, in which direction, and by how much are never read.
mechanism.what_the_book_does: A per-sector net-zero tercile long-short on the death-inclusive cohort: long punctual-process filers (low late-share), short latency-heavy filers (high late-share), quarterly decisions on the inherited 21-session grid, one grid step holding with rank hysteresis, exits at last close for dead legs, band-model costs charged exactly once per fill.
mechanism.when_it_must_fail: (i) process latency is efficiently priced: anchor expectancy <= 0 after base costs; (ii) the shuffled-chain control reproduces the anchor at >= 0.5x same-sign alpha - then the spread is a distributional artifact of the exposure's shape (history-length composition, sector composition, tie structure), not entity-linked process information, and the family dies; (iii) fewer than 2 of 3 folds positive or drop-one expectancy <= 0; (iv) any pre-selection identifiability or novelty gate fails - the proposal dies at D2 before any scored cell.
mechanism.which_control_kills_the_convenient_expla: The convenient explanation is 'the late-share terciles just hold small, old, low-price names; any variable correlated with them shows this spread'. The shuffled-chain control kills it: a within-sector, marginal-preserving permutation (seed 20260907, re-drawn per decision date) preserves the EXACT per-sector exposure value multiset - hence every distributional artifact: history-length composition, sector composition, tercile tie structure - and destroys only the entity-value link. If the anchor's alpha is an artifact, the control reproduces it at >= 0.5x same sign; if the alpha is entity-linked process information, the control collapses toward zero. The control runs under evidenced semantics (P-3): it permutes measured, evidenced exposure values; nothing asserted, nothing imputed; it recomputes under any semantics change.

falsifiable_prediction: Within-sector vintage-patch latency predicts next-quarter relative returns: the high-late-share tercile (short) underperforms the low-late-share tercile (long) in at least 2 of 3 folds S0_FOLD_1/2/3 after band costs, with (a) anchor expectancy > 0; (b) position PF >= 1.10; (c) populated-fold PF >= 0.8; (d) risk-matched SPY-excess alpha > 0 overall and positive in >= 2 of 3 folds; (e) ETF positive share <= 0.50 (expected 0.00 - the book holds no ETF legs); (f) max fold MDD <= 0.15; (g) the shuffled-chain control's |alpha| < 0.5x the anchor's alpha - same-sign reproduction at >= 0.5x kills the family; (h) the depth-extreme neighbour supports with same-sign alpha; (i) pre-selection gates R1-R5 pass at D2 before selection; (j) pooled Spearman |rho| <= 0.20 vs ALL eleven veto entries, measured at D2 before selection. Failure interpretations are preregistered in failure_interpretation - none is a tuning opportunity. Availability-lag mutation (P3 invariant): pushing any last_avail stamp later shifts the entity's exposure by at most one decision-grid step and changes nothing else; any larger shift is an implementation leak and the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed.

universe.bookable_pool: ALIVE_EVIDENCED (410) + DEAD_PRICE_CONFIRMED (1550) legs of research/control/stocks_free_v9_run/cohort_v9.json (sha256 6a95401ff84bff2144ac3c0b9426a6fa86daf3dde8d478195666249e3fa2aa62), carried unchanged per the P3-frozen death_inclusive_universe; NOT_DEAD_PRICE_SURVIVAL (219) and GAP_COVERAGE (513) excluded-with-reasons and never bookable in any arm; no survivorship re-substitution: a dead leg is never replaced by a successor entity's series and exits at its last recorded close.
universe.eligibility_per_decision: bookable pool AND >= 63 price bars through the decision date (inherited floor) AND ADV63 >= 2,000,000 USD (band C or better; UNTRADABLE excluded, L-I3 fail-closed) AND RAW close >= 1.00 USD AND |Q(e,t)| >= 4 qualifying chain groups (the P3-frozen min_hist own floor of 4; not tuned) AND the entity's frozen sector tag has >= 6 eligible ranked names, else that sector abstains the decision.
universe.sector_conditioning: frozen empirical SIC-to-SPDR majority map shipped in cohort_v9.json (sic_sector_map), carried unchanged; sector is the neutralizer, never the exposure.
universe.dead_leg_honesty: exit-at-last-close semantics carried from the V9/V10 P3 payloads; the exit cost path is resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing), never the silent fallback (L-I3). The dead-leg chain mass (1,023,812 of 1,667,422 chain groups, P0 census) enters the conditioning mass honestly; the 4,270 zero-post-window arrival events do not bind these arms because the arms are conditioning books on the session grid, not arrival-window books.

cited_funded_clocks.observable: inter_arrival_days / amend_count (cadence of the amendment process)
cited_funded_clocks.use: anchor late-share (inter_arrival_days > 460 = the funded pooled p90, frozen verbatim); the amend_count leg of this clock funds the H2 proposal, not this one's anchor

cited_funded_clocks.observable: vintage-chain depth (chain groups per filer-period; max depth per filer)
cited_funded_clocks.use: neighbour deep-share (share of as-of groups with depth >= 6)

clock.conditioning_rule: amendment_process clock semantics (p2_v11_coverage_first.json clock_semantics, verbatim): 'chain-shape conditioners are available at the group's LAST vintage stamp (last_avail): depth, amend_count, inter_arrival_days - the PROCESS, never corrected values (direction/severity usage is ancestry-vetoed at D2)'. A decision at session t observes a group only if last_avail < gate(t), gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; staleness bound 0 <= t - last_avail <= 800 days (max_age_days 800 everywhere; no unbounded variant). deadline_distance is DATA_BLOCKED_VALID and is never cited (P-1). V10-R1-REV-DIR and V10-R2-REV-MAG are not citable as signal inputs and enter no arm; no V10-T1/T2/T3 timing clock enters any arm; V11-E1-FILING-EVENT is not cited (no arrival-window book anywhere in this proposal).
clock.warmup_note: no own_norm/cohort_norm seeding required - the exposure is a raw share of a bounded count read directly per as-of group

warmup_rationale: the exposure reads evidenced stamps directly per depth>=2 chain group as of the decision (a share of a bounded count; no own/cohort norm seeding, no delta-of-levels legs - V8 F2 ratio-level precedent warmup 0); the grid's index-63 start already seeds the 63-bar and ADV63 eligibility floors; those floors are eligibility/cost machinery, not signal warmup.

decision_grid.schedule: inherited 21-session grid: sessions at indices 63+21k from each fold start (k = 0, 1, 2, ...), pure session-index schedule, no calendar anchoring; approximately 26-28 scored decisions per fold, >= 75 overall (exact counts fixed by the session grid before scoring).
decision_grid.no_finer_grid_rationale: no finer grid demanded and none declared: amendment stamps accrue at last_avail cadence (pooled inter-arrival p50 = 364 days per the funded clock), so a 21-session step cannot systematically sample inside a sub-step arrival, and the availability-lag mutation guarantees stamp shifts propagate by whole evidence stamps, not intra-grid timing.

entry_exit_fills.signal_semantics: signals computed on session t close data under last_avail < gate(t), gate(t) = 00:00 UTC of the decision session; fills at the next allowed session close (V3 ADJ-1-EXEC-CLOCK; no same-session fill).
entry_exit_fills.fill_check: a fill references only names with a bar at the fill session; missing bar = the order does not exist (no silent substitute pricing).
entry_exit_fills.exit_at_last_close: a held name whose series ends is exited at its last recorded close on its final session (delisting-return leg carried by the price series itself; no synthetic penalty, no synthetic continuation); exit costs via resolve_exit_band_bps - C-rate ceiling when the band has become UNTRADABLE/missing, never the silent fallback (L-I3 fail-closed).
entry_exit_fills.holding: one grid step (21 trading sessions) with rank-hysteresis: a held name is retained until its rank exits its tercile band by more than one decile (effective holding 1-2 quarters); book forced flat at every fold boundary.
entry_exit_fills.portfolio_construction: per-sector net-zero long-short: within each sector tag with >= 6 eligible ranked names, long the bottom tercile and short the top tercile of the exposure (descending = short), equal-weight within legs, per-sector net zero; CASH absorbs residual; >= 1 non-CASH leg per decision; gross capped 2.0; all books reconcile to 1.0 within 1e-9. Tercile boundaries: midrank ties at a boundary join the lower (long) tercile - deterministic and conservative (the short leg is strictly the highest exposures). The book_form provision 2.1 is deliberately NOT invoked: the book holds cohort equities only (no SPY/sector-ETF legs), because per-sector net-zero construction already neutralizes sector exposure without paying ETF-leg costs and without diluting exit-at-last-close death-leg honesty.

costs.model: inherited band model, charged exactly once per fill, linear in fills, applied to BOOKED PnL, no sidecar: research/assets/stocks/kernel_band_cost_v9.py verbatim - BAND_BPS = {"A": 10.0, "B": 15.0, "C": 25.0}; band_of: ADV63 >= 50,000,000 -> A, >= 10,000,000 -> B, >= 2,000,000 -> C, else UNTRADABLE; fill_cost_bps = abs(dw) * resolve_band_bps(name, bands) * cost_mult / 10_000.0.
costs.fail_closed: a traded name without a computed band at costing raises BandResolutionError - the silent 10 bps fallback is forbidden (L-I3); an entry never reaches costing with an UNTRADABLE band; exits of held names use resolve_exit_band_bps (own band when tradable, C-rate 25 bps ceiling when UNTRADABLE/missing).
costs.stress: stress rerun is cost_mult 2.0 (20/30/50 bps per side) applied to booked PnL; reported alongside base.
costs.expected_blend: the dead leg skews to lower dollar volume, so the blended base cost is expected between 15 and 25 bps per side; fills, cost and booked PnL reported split by band for base AND stress.

arms.arms_note: exactly three arms per binding rule - anchor, neighbour, control; every other key in this object is a note, not an arm. All arms RUN under evidenced semantics (P-3): every input row is a staged depth>=2 chain group with a recorded last_avail stamp; no asserted timestamps anywhere (P-1); each arm is testable under the P3 availability-lag mutation; the control recomputes under any semantics change.
arms.anchor: late-share latency exposure: late_share(e,t) = |{g in Q(e,t) : inter_arrival_days(g) > 460}| / |Q(e,t)| (formula in exposure_definition), per-sector long-low/short-high terciles. Claim: the share of an entity's as-of amendment chains whose re-addressal arrived far above the annual reporting rhythm predicts negative drift on the latency-heavy names.
arms.neighbour: depth-extreme share (required SUPPORT, same sign): deep_share(e,t) = |{g in Q(e,t) : depth(g) >= 6}| / |Q(e,t)| under V11-E2-CHAIN-DEPTH; depth 6 is the census-histogram boundary immediately beyond the modal depth-5 mass (604,376 groups at depth 5; the depth >= 6 tail is 125,517 groups, derived by subtraction from the P0 census depth histogram). Chains that outrun the modal amendment pattern are the strain-volume companion of the latency reading; if deep_share carries the opposite sign, the latency-as-strain interpretation is withdrawn (declared support-failure, not a tuning opportunity).
arms.control: shuffled-chain falsification control preserving marginals: for each decision date t, within each sector tag, permute the anchor's late_share values uniformly across that sector's eligible names (numpy PCG64 seed 20260907, permutation applied to the CIK-sorted index vector, re-drawn per decision date in session-index order - fully deterministic and frozen). The control book runs the IDENTICAL per-sector tercile machinery on the permuted exposures. It preserves the exact per-sector exposure value multiset (all distributional artifacts survive intact) and destroys only the entity-value link. Kill rule: control |alpha| >= 0.5x anchor |alpha| with the same sign -> the spread is a distributional artifact, not entity-linked process information -> the family is falsified per the falsification-by-control cluster (RULES section 2.3).
arms.intended_correlation_profile_and_why_it_: anchor vs control: by marginal preservation the control's rank structure is a random relabelling of the anchor's - declared expected pooled Spearman rho 0.00-0.10, gate 0.30 (pre_selection_identifiability_check R1). The control's discriminating power: an artifact (composition, ties, sector shape) lives in the value multiset and survives permutation; entity-linked process content does not. Correlation declared ex ante, measured at D2 before selection, never argued post hoc.

exposure_definition: At each decision date t (session gate g(t) = 00:00 UTC of session t), for entity e: Q(e,t) = { (f, p) chain groups of e in the staged v10_revision_observables.jsonl layer (sha256 7110cbf010ae6d3f414a1a45eec1e504aff5e94464755991e98605e4795657c2; one row per depth>=2 filer-field-period group) satisfying last_avail(g) < g(t) and 0 <= t - last_avail(g) <= 800 days }. Exposure value: late_share(e,t) = |{g in Q(e,t) : inter_arrival_days(g) > 460}| / |Q(e,t)|, defined iff |Q(e,t)| >= 4; entities with |Q| < 4 are ineligible (not zero-ranked). The cut 460 is the P2-published pooled cadence p90 (funded clock tuple '169/364/460'), read from the census, single-valued, frozen - not searched. Ranking direction: descending late_share = short side, ascending = long side. Normalization: none beyond the share (raw value used for ranking AND for the D2 veto measurement - the within-sector tercile standardization applied for trading is monotone within sector and the veto is measured on the raw pooled rank, midrank ties, the conservative choice). Inputs: inter_arrival_days, last_avail, and the group key only; no price, no level ratio, no delta-of-levels, no corrected value, no direction, no magnitude. The same formula, evaluated on the same cohort and frozen decision dates, is what D2 ranks against each veto entry (Spearman, midrank ties, pooled).

pre_selection_identifiability_check.purpose: the V8 a5 lesson: control identifiability and anchor non-vacuity must be measurable BEFORE selection, from data alone, no PnL in existence.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.rule: On every frozen decision date t over S0_FOLD_1/2/3, over the pre-check universe = bookable-pool names with >= 63 price bars through t (bar counts from the sha-pinned staged price bars; NO band computation, NO returns): (R1) RANK GATE - pooled |mean Spearman rho| between the anchor rank vector and the shuffled-control rank vector <= 0.30, and per-date rho <= 0.30 on >= 90% of dates (declared expected band 0.00-0.10: a within-sector marginal-preserving permutation leaves expected rank correlation near zero); (R2) CONTROL NON-DEGENERACY - by marginal preservation the control terciles populate with the anchor's own counts; measured anyway: both control terciles contain >= 6 names on >= 90% of dates; (R3) ANCHOR COVERAGE - the anchor rank is populated on >= 60% of the measured universe on >= 90% of dates; (R4) ANCHOR SHORT-LEG POPULATION - the anchor's top tercile contains >= 6 names with late_share > 0 on >= 90% of dates; (R5) SECTOR PARTICIPATION - on >= 90% of dates, >= 60% of the measured universe sits in sectors passing the >= 6-name rule (else the book is too abstaining to trade). Declared expected outcome: R1 in the 0.00-0.10 band. Any gate failure blocks the proposal BEFORE selection (INELIGIBLE_CONTROL_UNIDENTIFIABLE / INELIGIBLE_VACUOUS_CONTROL / INELIGIBLE_BOOK_UNPOPULATED, fail-closed, V4 + V8 a5 precedent); the check runs at D2 alongside novelty and its bytes are published before any scored cell.
pre_selection_identifiability_check.inputs: the staged revision/timing observable layers under the cited clocks + staged price bar availability ONLY; no ADV, no cost model, no returns - nothing scored exists at measurement time.

incremental_alpha_test.vs_SPY: incremental alpha = arm return minus risk-matched SPY context (SPY scaled ex ante by the arm's frozen gross/vol rule per the P3-carried factor/benchmark protocol), per fold and overall; require excess positive in >= 2 of 3 folds AND overall SPY-excess alpha > 0 (SPY-excess positivity declared here, binding at scoring); raw PnL or long-equity beta is never accepted as alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.vs_sector_ETF: same test against the equal-weight mapped sector-ETF factor (SPY + 11 SPDR sector files, verified-by-pin); the book is per-sector net zero so residual sector drift appears as reported tracking error, not alpha.
incremental_alpha_test.etf_share_gate: ETF positive share <= 0.50 where ETF legs exist; this book declares NO ETF legs (2.1 provision not invoked), so the measured share is expected 0.00 with the gate binding only if an implementation path ever introduced ETF legs.
incremental_alpha_test.stage_a_gates_applied_with_no_relaxation: expectancy > 0; position PF >= 1.1; folds positive >= 2; populated-fold PF >= 0.8; max fold MDD <= 0.15; ETF positive share <= 0.50; fold positive share <= 0.5; anchor overall SPY-excess alpha > 0; control |alpha| ratio < 0.5; neighbour same-sign support required; margin-to-fail reported for every gate on a survivor (P-2); reproduction ALL_MATCH from a detached tree.

turnover_and_sample_floor.decisions_total: >= 30 scored decision periods overall (declared grid approx. 78); >= 5 per fold.
turnover_and_sample_floor.turnover_convention: turnover = sum(abs(delta_weight)) over non-CASH legs (V3 ADJ-5 corrected); annualized two-way with hysteresis expected below the 6.0/year ceiling; raw and ceiling-normalized reported.
turnover_and_sample_floor.floor_mechanics: min 5 decision periods per fold; min 1 non-CASH leg per decision; CASH excluded from turnover, concentration and drop-one; force-flat at fold boundaries.

drop_one_design: drop-one-symbol: rerun excluding the max-contribution symbol; survival requires after-drop expectancy > 0 (dead-leg names are legitimate exclusions; the max contributor may be a dying name - that is a legitimate drop, not a special case).
drop-one-fold: min over folds of expectancy with that fold removed; survival requires min > 0.

drop-one-process-leg: recompute late_share over only groups with depth >= 3 (multi-resubmission chains - the latency observations of the most confidently re-addressed periods); survival requires sign preservation and expectancy > 0; if the premium exists only across single-amendment groups, the latency-strain reading is withdrawn.

margin_to_fail_expectations.note: declared BEFORE any scored PnL exists, per P-2; anticipations, not thresholds - the binding thresholds are the frozen gate list and nothing here relaxes them.
margin_to_fail_expectations.expectancy_gt_0: MOST LIKELY BINDING GATE: 10-25 bps per side on a quarterly book whose short leg concentrates latency-heavy, often low-ADV names; the anticipated margin is small and positive if the channel is real, and the stress rerun (2x) is expected to consume roughly half of it.
margin_to_fail_expectations.position_pf_ge_1.1: second-most-likely binding; a low-salience drift channel is expected to produce PF in the 1.05-1.25 band if real; thin margin declared ex ante.
margin_to_fail_expectations.folds_positive_ge_2_and_fold_positive_sh: S0_FOLD_1 (2018-04..2020-09) is the anticipated weak fold: the Feb-Mar 2020 terminal event realizes the short side violently, then mean-reverts inside the hysteresis holding window; declared risk is fold-1-negative / folds-2-3-positive, which still passes the >= 2 gate.
margin_to_fail_expectations.max_fold_mdd_le_0.15: expected to pass with margin for a per-sector net-zero book at gross <= 2.0; tail risk is death clustering on the short leg inside one sector-quarter, only partially capped by the 63-bar/band floors.
margin_to_fail_expectations.etf_positive_share_le_0.50: expected 0.00 by no-ETF-leg construction; full margin declared.
margin_to_fail_expectations.spy_excess_and_sector_etf_alpha: the specificity-of-information gates: expected positive if and only if the latency channel carries information beyond market/sector context; the V10 sector-drowning lesson (ETF-share 0.8333, SPY-excess 0/3) is the failure mode this family's net-zero construction is built to avoid, not a guarantee.
margin_to_fail_expectations.control_alpha_abs_ratio_lt_0.5: THE FALSIFICATION GATE: expected to pass if and only if entity-linked process content (not distributional shape) carries the spread; the R1-R5 pre-selection gates exist precisely so this comparison is meaningful if reached.
margin_to_fail_expectations.novelty_pooled_rho_le_0.20: expected 0.00-0.10 given process-only inputs (no price, no value, no direction); a fail dies at D2 before any scored cell - the cheap death.
margin_to_fail_expectations.margin_to_fail_reporting: at scoring, every gate reports its distance to the failure threshold; a survivor reporting knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% of MDD headroom) is treated as thin-margin class per P-2 regardless of pass count.

failure_interpretation.anchor_expectancy_le_0: process latency is already efficiently priced on this cohort or does not transmit to relative returns - withdraw the family; no rescue variant (REJECT is a successful outcome).
failure_interpretation.control_ratio_ge_0.5_same_sign: the spread is a distributional artifact of the exposure's shape, not entity-linked process information - family dies; this is the pre-declared falsification outcome and a successful test (falsification-by-control cluster precedent).
failure_interpretation.neighbour_opposite_sign: the latency reading is not coherent with chain-depth strain - withdraw the strain interpretation (support-failure, not a tuning opportunity).
failure_interpretation.folds_positive_lt_2_or_fold_positive_sha: the effect does not survive regime change - die.
failure_interpretation.spy_excess_fail: the spread is market/sector context, not incremental information - die (the measured V10 sector-drowning lesson applied to this family).
failure_interpretation.etf_share_gt_0.50: sector leakage through the book construction - die.
failure_interpretation.populated_fold_pf_lt_0.8: the book degrades to noise in some regime - die.
failure_interpretation.pre_selection_gate_fail_R1_R5: die at D2 before any scored cell (INELIGIBLE_*); the design never reaches PnL - the cheap death, correctly taken.
failure_interpretation.novelty_fail: the process conditioning is a hedged relabelling of a vetoed ancestor - die at D2; measured, never argued.
failure_interpretation.availability_lag_mutation_fail: implementation leak - the arm is NOT_RUN fail-closed; no repair after PnL is visible.
failure_interpretation.thin_margin_rule: a survivor with knife-edge margins (< 0.05 PF margin, < 25% MDD headroom) is reported thin per P-2 regardless of pass count and is treated as candidate-not-edge.

frozen_thresholds.latency_cut_source: V11-E3-AMEND-CADENCE funded tuple 'cadence_p10_p50_p90_days': '169/364/460' - the pooled p90, read from P2, not searched
frozen_thresholds.neighbour_depth_cut_source: first census-histogram boundary beyond the modal depth-5 mass (604,376 groups at depth 5), declared once
frozen_thresholds.terciles: long bottom / short top; boundary ties join the long tercile
frozen_thresholds.hysteresis: retain until rank exits tercile band by more than one decile

no_parameter_grid_declaration: No parameter grid exists anywhere in this proposal: every constant in frozen_thresholds is single-valued and frozen at wave SHA ea668797b661dfa2c9d2b2799e46fe0f13f71820 before any scored outcome exists. The latency cut is the P2-published pooled p90 (460), read from the funded clock tuple; the neighbour depth cut is a single census-histogram boundary; the permutation seed is a fixed integer; terciles, hysteresis, gross cap, grid, floors and gates are inherited single-valued conventions. No scan over cuts, depths, quantiles, seeds, universes or thresholds is declared or permitted; any post-PnL change to any constant is rescue and is forbidden.

novelty_declaration.novelty_standard: measured decorrelation pooled |rho| <= 0.20 vs every one of the eleven veto entries, measured at D2 BEFORE selection on the raw exposure rank (Spearman, midrank ties, pooled over the frozen decision dates and cohort) - never prose; the exposure formula above is written so D2 can compute the rank correlation directly.
novelty_declaration.momentum_incl_V2_ETF_relative: CLEAN BY INPUT DISJOINTNESS - no price series, return, or lagged-return quantity enters any exposure; the only price-derived quantities are the 63-bar floor, ADV63 band eligibility and the >= 1.00 price floor, all sanctioned eligibility/cost machinery, not signals. D2 gate: pooled |rho| <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.semivariance: CLEAN - no variance, semivariance, or OHLC-derived shape quantity anywhere. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.vol_level: CLEAN - no vol-level, band-of-vol, or range quantity. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.WC_stock_intensity: CLEAN BY CONSTRUCTION - no working-capital level, stock, or intensity is computed; field labels appear only as the group key over which the stamp-spacing share is taken, never as values. D2 gate <= 0.20 (measured, never argued).
novelty_declaration.Goodwill_bloat: CLEAN - no Goodwill and no Assets quantity enters any arm. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.F1_accrual_flow: CLEAN - no accrual flow composite, no delta-of-levels; the exposure lives entirely on vintage stamps. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.depletion_runway_interaction: CLEAN - no (delta-RE, Cash, Assets) construction and no interaction form of any rejected family. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.cash_level_shadow: CLEAN - no cash or asset level enters any arm. D2 gate <= 0.20.
novelty_declaration.sector_exposure_form: CLEAN BY DESIGN - per-sector net-zero book; sector is the neutralizer, not the exposure; the ETF-share gate and the SPY/sector-ETF incremental-alpha tests cover the long-beta masquerade (V4 participation lesson). D2 gate <= 0.20 on the raw exposure rank.
novelty_declaration.v10_deseasonalized_timing_own_z: DIFFERENT LAYER AND STATISTIC - own_z was a TIMING-axis characteristic: first-vintage filing lag standardized by the entity's own history (V10-T2, first_avail semantics, deseasonalized). H1 is a REVISION-axis spacing characteristic: inter-vintage arrival gaps under last_avail semantics, evaluated against a FIXED pooled census percentile (460), with no standardization by own history and no first-vintage lag anywhere. D2 gate <= 0.20 measured on the raw late_share rank.
novelty_declaration.v10_revision_correction_direction_breadt: PROCESS, NOT VALUE - addressed head-on. The vetoed V10 A5-H1 exposure was down-incidence breadth: the share of groups whose corrected VALUE moved DOWN (rev_dir), with severity (rev_mag) as neighbour - both dead at -0.2047/-0.2093 per the frozen V10 terminal, and their USAGE FORMS are veto entries. H1 never reads a corrected value, a direction, or a magnitude: late_share is computed purely from the SPACING of evidenced vintage stamps (inter_arrival_days), a quantity that exists independent of whether a correction was up, down, or flat. The runner loads only (entity, field, period, last_avail, inter_arrival_days, depth); the direction/magnitude columns of the same staged file are never parsed into any exposure - an I-phase recursive leak scan can verify this at record depth.
